AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_purchase ip WHERE ip.customer_id = c.id AND ip.item_type = #{itemType} AND ip.qty > ip.voided_qty)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_member m WHERE m.customer_id = c.id AND m.relation = #{relation})
